source_spec: Vibe Browser MCP tool annotations v1 (Oct 18, 2026) — canonical copy in the connectors execution pack; verified against prod tools/list (27 tools) + 10 appendix tools

definitions.read: Retrieves information without changing data, account state, or permissions.
definitions.write: Creates, changes, or deletes data, or acts on the user's behalf in the browser.
definitions.sensitive_write: Write with irreversible or consequential side effects (sends email, deletes data, runs arbitrary code, or can activate purchase/submit controls). Requires approval on every use in Muse.

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.title: Navigate page
tools.note: Changes the browser location and history.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List open tabs
tools.note: Lists open tabs; local browser state only.

tools.name: new_page
tools.title: Open new tab
tools.note: Opens a new tab.

tools.name: close_page
tools.title: Close tab
tools.note: Can discard unsaved page state when closing a tab.

tools.name: click
tools.title: Click element
tools.note: Worst-case classification: a click can activate submit, delete, or purchase controls.

tools.name: fill
tools.title: Fill field
tools.note: Edits a single field; does not submit.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.title: Fill form fields
tools.note: Edits multiple fields; does not submit.

tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text
tools.note: Types into the focused field; does not submit.

tools.name: scroll_page
tools.title: Scroll page
tools.note: Moves the viewport only.

tools.name: media_control
tools.title: Control media playback
tools.note: Changes playback state (play/pause/mute) on the page.

tools.name: press_key
tools.title: Press key
tools.note: Worst-case classification: keys can submit forms (Enter) or delete content.

tools.name: hover
tools.title: Hover element
tools.note: Reveals tooltips/menus; no persistent change.

tools.name: drag
tools.title: Drag element
tools.note: Moves page elements; outcome depends on the drop target.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.title: Take page snapshot
tools.note: Reads the page content (accessibility snapshot).

tools.name: take_html_snapshot
tools.title: Take HTML snapshot
tools.note: Reads the page HTML.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.title: Take screenshot
tools.note: Captures a page screenshot.

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.title: Run page JavaScript
tools.note: Runs arbitrary JavaScript in the page context — highest reviewer-risk tool.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.title: List network requests
tools.note: Reads the local network capture buffer.

tools.name: get_network_request
tools.title: Get network request details
tools.note: Reads the local network capture buffer.

tools.name: wait
tools.title: Wait
tools.note: Pauses; changes nothing.

tools.name: gmail_search
tools.title: Search Gmail
tools.note: Searches Gmail; read-only.

tools.name: gmail_get_message
tools.title: Read email message
tools.note: Reads an email message.

tools.name: gmail_get_thread
tools.title: Read email thread
tools.note: Reads an email thread.

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.title: Create email draft
tools.note: Creates an editable draft; nothing is sent.

tools.name: gmail_send_message
tools.title: Send email
tools.note: Irreversible external side effect: sends email to recipients.

tools.name: calendar_view
tools.title: View calendar events
tools.note: Reads events via the Calendar API.

tools.name: calendar_create
tools.title: Create calendar event
tools.note: Creates a new calendar event on each call.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.title: Wait for page text
tools.note: Waits for text to appear; read-only.

tools.name: subagent
tools.title: Spawn sub-agent
tools.note: Spawns a sub-agent that can use any of the user's tools.

tools.name: parallel
tools.title: Run tools in parallel
tools.note: Meta-tool: inherits the worst-case effect of the bundled calls.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Fetch web page
tools.note: HTTP fetch with text extraction.

tools.name: calendar_delete
tools.title: Delete calendar event
tools.note: Deletes calendar events (destructive).

tools.name: secrets_manager
tools.title: List saved credentials
tools.note: Lists vault entries by name; secret values are never returned.

tools.name: typein_secret
tools.title: Type saved credential into form
tools.note: Types a saved credential into a form; the secret value is never exposed to the model.

tools.name: settings
tools.title: Read or update settings
tools.note: Mixed read/write tool; the update path is destructive. Split recommended.

tools.name: settings_list
tools.title: List settings & skills
tools.note: Lists stored settings and skill entries.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.title: Search stored memories
tools.note: Searches the extension's stored context.
